Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct
data = open('testcase.bin','rb').read()
off = 0
magic = data[off:off+4]; off+=4
print('magic', magic)
l_text = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
print('l_text', l_text)
text = data[off:off+l_text]; off+=l_text
print('text', repr(text))
n_ref = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
print('n_ref', n_ref)
for i in range(n_ref):
    l_name = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
    name = data[off:off+l_name]; off+=l_name
    l_ref = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
    print('ref', i, 'l_name', l_name, 'name', name, 'l_ref', l_ref)
print('offset after header', off, 'remaining', len(data)-off)
# parse alignment records
while off < len(data):
    block_len = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
    print('block_len', block_len)
    core = struct.unpack('<8i', data[off:off+32]); off+=32
    tid,pos,bin_qual_qname,flag_ncigar,l_qseq,mtid,mpos,isize = core
    bin = bin_qual_qname>>16; qual=(bin_qual_qname>>8)&0xff; l_qname=bin_qual_qname&0xff
    flag=flag_ncigar>>16; n_cigar=flag_ncigar&0xffff
    print('  tid',tid,'pos',pos,'bin',bin,'qual',qual,'l_qname',l_qname,'flag',flag,'n_cigar',n_cigar,'l_qseq',l_qseq,'mtid',mtid,'mpos',mpos,'isize',isize)
    l_extranul = (4 - l_qname%4)%4
    print('  l_extranul', l_extranul)
    qname = data[off:off+l_qname]; off+=l_qname
    print('  qname', repr(qname))
    off += l_extranul
    l_data_rest = block_len - 32 + l_extranul - l_qname - l_extranul
    # cigar
    cigar = data[off:off+n_cigar*4]; off+=n_cigar*4
    print('  cigar', cigar.hex())
    seq = data[off:off+(l_qseq+1)//2]; off+=(l_qseq+1)//2
    print('  seq', seq.hex())
    qual2 = data[off:off+l_qseq]; off+=l_qseq
    print('  qual', qual2.hex())
    print('  remaining in block', block_len - 32 - l_qname - l_extranul - n_cigar*4 - (l_qseq+1)//2 - l_qseq)
    break
"
